budget_items.topic: Library additional salary funding (special town meeting article)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library Director asked for an additional salary amount for the library salary line to cover staff time for school-sponsored 5th grade visits; the minutes say there is no money in the budget for it and the request was rolled into Article 1 of the town warrant.
budget_items.quote: asking for an additional $7200.00 to apply to the library's salary line budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW funding article amount was reduced due to attrition and retirements and is to be a transfer from the salary reserve.
budget_items.quote: article three regarding the dpw funding will be less than previously stated, due to attrition and retirements, at $8049.80. this will be a transfer from the salary reserve.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The salary survey will be done free of charge as a pilot community, so the related article will be passed over.
budget_items.quote: it will be done free of charge as a pilot community so the article will be passed over.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash was certified on October 17; the original estimate and the certified figure were reported.
budget_items.quote: the original estimate was $1,531, 000. the certified figure is $1,512,483.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Retained earnings of the water, sewer and trash enterprise funds were certified at the amounts stated; the trash fund is funded by sales of yellow trash bags.
budget_items.quote: the retained earnings of the enterprise funds were certified at $52,790 in water, $1,929,110 in sewer, and $1,086 in trash.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Prior discussion on whether to pay anything down debt was reported; no bonds are available for a couple of years, so no action now.
budget_items.quote: there had been previous discussion between town finance and financial planning as to whether it made sense to pay anything down.

budget_items.topic: Investment diversification limit and bank balances
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The policy change would raise the single-institution limit from 10% to 25%; at fiscal year-end FY2018 the minutes give each institution's share of town cash, all said to be fully insured.
budget_items.quote: the current is that no more than 10% of the town's investment be in a single institution. the revised would be 25%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Engine four had inspection issues with the pump; the repair is estimated at a cost range if the parts can be located, and a new fire engine would take about 300 days.
budget_items.quote: it will cost $5,000-7,000 if they can locate the parts, as it is a 1995 engine.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library trustees asked how to access old trust funds for a funding request; Karen Brochu gave the library a report on how much is available. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: she provided her with a report on the trust funds and how much funds are available.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: As an aside, the Town Charter update noted that the ham and bean supper at The Eagle House raised money.
budget_items.quote: the ham and bean supper at the eagle house raised $997.00.
